change: The sole security workflow diff appends the exact final-image OpenSSL regression to the existing offline ABI test command. Scanners, severity scopes, source guards and all existing tests remain unchanged.
workflow_diff:

           PY
       - name: Verify the changed Agent native library ABI without provider calls
         if: matrix.service == 'agent'
